_comment: Meshy prompts (docs/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md). Characters are the lane drama's main cast by the owner's decision (COPYRIGHT_REGISTER C-201); keys are the unit/enemy ids they play. Never name the series or an actor, never ask for a real person's likeness: describe period costume and props only. 'style'/'texture_style' are prepended to character prompts, 'prop_style' to props.
style: Chibi-proportioned stylized cartoon game character (oversized head about one third of total height, short sturdy body, big hands and feet), like a collectible vinyl toy for a mobile tower-defense game, clean simple shapes, bold readable silhouette, full body standing in T-pose, facing the camera, no base, no background.
texture_style: Hand-painted flat colors, soft shading, no photorealism, warm Mediterranean palette, clean cloth folds, friendly expressive face.
enemy_texture_style: Hand-painted flat colors, soft shading, no photorealism, colder palette of indigo, basalt grey and olive with red accents, clean cloth folds, hostile scowling expressive face, menacing but never grotesque, no caricature.

animations._comment: Meshy library action ids, filled after running `python tools/meshy/meshy.py library`. One clip per file so Roblox imports each as its own track. Defenders need idle + attack; the auto-rig already returns a free walk clip for attackers.

umm_hara.prompt: Abu Issam, the respected barber and healer (hakim) of a 1930s Damascus neighbourhood, slim middle-aged man with a neat black handlebar moustache, red felt fez (tarboosh), long cream striped qumbaz robe under a dark brown wool jacket, wide cloth sash, a small leather bag of remedies on his shoulder, holding a straight razor, kind but serious face.
umm_hara.texture: Red fez, cream qumbaz with thin brown stripes, dark brown jacket, beige sash, tan leather bag, steel razor, tan skin.

hallaq.prompt: Issam, the barber's eldest son and apprentice in a 1930s Damascus neighbourhood, young man in his twenties with a short tidy black beard and moustache, red fez, white collarless shirt, black waistcoat, white barber's apron, dark baggy sherwal trousers, holding scissors and a comb, calm friendly face.
hallaq.texture: Red fez, white shirt and apron, black waistcoat, charcoal trousers, steel scissors, tan skin.

qabaday.prompt: Mo'taz, a hot-headed young neighbourhood strongman ('akeed) of 1930s Damascus, athletic young man with a short black beard and upturned moustache, red fez, white shirt with rolled sleeves, black embroidered waistcoat, wide red-and-black striped sash with a curved dagger tucked in, black baggy sherwal trousers, leather boots, fierce determined face.
qabaday.texture: Red fez, white shirt, black waistcoat with gold embroidery, red-black striped sash, black trousers, steel dagger with brass hilt, tan skin.

zaim_akbar.prompt: Al-'Akeed Abu Shehab, the legendary protector of a 1930s Damascus neighbourhood, broad powerful man with a full black beard and thick moustache, fez wrapped with a white cloth band, black shirt, black embroidered waistcoat, wide striped sash with a curved dagger, black baggy sherwal trousers, heavy boots, proud stern heroic pose.
zaim_akbar.texture: Black clothing with gold embroidery, white head-cloth band on a red fez, brown and gold striped sash, steel dagger, tan skin.

zaim.prompt: Za'im Abu Saleh, elderly leader and judge of a 1930s Damascus neighbourhood, dignified old man with a full white beard, fez wrapped with a white cloth band, long grey qumbaz robe, long black open cloak (aba) with gold trim, holding a wooden walking cane, wise calm face.
zaim.texture: Red fez with white band, grey robe, black cloak with gold trim, dark wood cane, white beard, tan skin.

qahwaji.prompt: Abu Hatem, proud portly owner of a 1930s Damascus coffee house, plump man with a thick black moustache, red fez, long striped qumbaz robe under a short dark jacket, carrying a brass coffee pot with a long spout and a small cup, smug self-satisfied face.
qahwaji.texture: Red fez, green and cream striped robe, dark jacket, shiny brass coffee pot, tan skin.

mukhtar.prompt: Abu Badr, the comically nervous loudmouth of a 1930s Damascus neighbourhood, skinny man with a huge black moustache and wide worried eyes, red fez slightly askew, striped qumbaz robe with a sash, holding a wooden stick he is clearly afraid to use, funny cowardly pose.
mukhtar.texture: Red fez, blue-grey striped robe, beige sash, light wood stick, tan skin.

saqqa.prompt: Fawzia, the bossy loud-hearted wife in a 1930s Damascus neighbourhood, plump middle-aged woman with a headscarf and a long modest house dress with an apron, both hands open and empty (nothing held, no broom), arms straight out to the sides, confident scolding expression, modest clothing.
saqqa.texture: Plum purple dress, golden headscarf, cream apron, tan skin.
saqqa._note: v2 (2026-10-17): no broom in the mesh. Meshy fused the v1 broom into the body (bristles glued to the floor when animated); the broom is now a held prop (src/shared/Anim/HandProps.luau).

khayyat.prompt: Abu Ghalib, gossiping street seller of boiled chickpeas in 1930s Damascus, middle-aged man with grey stubble and a moustache, white skull cap, brown waistcoat over a beige shirt, apron, carrying a big steaming copper pot of chickpeas with a ladle, sly gossipy grin.
khayyat.texture: White cap, beige shirt, brown waistcoat, cream apron, copper pot, golden chickpeas, tan skin.

farran.prompt: Abu Bashir, the loyal strong baker of a 1930s Damascus neighbourhood, stout cheerful man with a thick moustache and stubble, small round white cotton skull cap (not a chef's hat), rolled sleeves, flour-dusted white apron over a beige shirt, baggy brown trousers, holding a long wooden bread peel with a round flatbread.
farran.texture: White skull cap and apron dusted with flour, beige shirt, brown trousers, golden-brown flatbread, tan skin.

spy.prompt: Al-Nims, sneaky comic spy from a rival 1930s Damascus neighbourhood, very thin man with a pencil moustache and shifty eyes, red fez, patched striped robe, carrying a brass hand-pump sprayer, tiptoeing sneaky pose.
spy.texture: Red fez, faded patched striped robe, brass sprayer, tan skin.

chief_thief.prompt: Al-Idaashari, a cunning gambler and thief of 1930s Damascus, wiry man with stubble and a sly grin, dark head scarf, dark shirt and baggy trousers, carrying a small sack of stolen gold coins.
chief_thief.texture: Dark brown and black clothing, beige sack with gold coins, tan skin.

rival_zaim.prompt: Abu al-Nar, the fierce 'akeed of a rival 1930s Damascus neighbourhood, burly man with a thick black beard, fez wrapped with a dark cloth band, dark green waistcoat, wide sash with a curved dagger, black baggy trousers, menacing pose.
rival_zaim.texture: Dark green waistcoat, black clothes, dark head band on a red fez, steel dagger, tan skin.

natour.prompt: 1930s Damascus night watchman, weathered man with a grey short beard and thick moustache, checkered head cloth held by a black cord, long dark brown robe with a brown cloak, holding an iron oil lantern in his right hand.
natour.texture: Off-white and red checkered head cloth, dark brown robe and cloak, warm glowing yellow lantern glass, tan skin.

walad.prompt: Cheeky 1930s Damascus neighbourhood boy, about ten years old, white skull cap, cream shirt with an indigo vest, baggy dark trousers, bare feet in sandals, holding a leather sling.
walad.texture: White cap, cream shirt, indigo vest, dark trousers, brown sling, light tan skin.

haddad.prompt: Abu Khater, the stubborn coppersmith of a 1930s Damascus neighbourhood, very broad muscular man with a full black beard and thick moustache, bare head with short black hair, grey shirt with rolled sleeves, thick dark leather apron, heavy boots, holding a large iron hammer.
haddad.texture: Grey shirt, dark brown leather apron, black iron hammer head, wooden handle, soot marks, tan skin.

pahlawan.prompt: Giant 1930s traditional strongman wrestler, enormous muscular man with a handlebar moustache and stubble, bare arms, red sleeveless top, black baggy sherwal trousers with a wide black belt, fists clenched.
pahlawan.texture: Red top, black trousers and belt, tan skin.

arada.prompt: 1930s Damascus festive sword-and-shield dancer, energetic man with a short beard and handlebar moustache, red fez, white shirt, red sash, baggy black trousers, holding a straight sword and a small round brass shield.
arada.texture: Red fez, white shirt, crimson sash, black trousers, steel sword, polished brass shield, tan skin.

gendarme.prompt: 1930s colonial-era gendarme soldier, slim man with a thin moustache, dark blue kepi cap with a black peak, dark blue uniform jacket with gold buttons, brown leather belt and cross strap, tall black boots, holding a bolt-action rifle.
gendarme.texture: Navy blue uniform, gold buttons and cap band, brown leather straps, black boots, wooden rifle, light skin.

thief.prompt: Sneaky 1930s night thief, lean man with stubble, dark head scarf wrapped around his head, dark brown shirt and baggy trousers, carrying a big sack over his shoulder.
thief.texture: Very dark brown and black clothing, beige sack, tan skin.

hallaq_barber_v1.prompt: 1930s Damascus neighbourhood barber, slim middle-aged man with a black handlebar moustache, red felt fez with a black tassel, white collarless shirt, long white apron, black open waistcoat, dark baggy sherwal trousers, leather slippers, holding a straight razor in his right hand.
hallaq_barber_v1.texture: Red fez, crisp white apron and shirt, black waistcoat with thin gold trim, dark brown trousers, tan skin.

qitt.prompt: The beloved ginger street cat of a 1930s Damascus neighbourhood, chubby orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a curled tail, sitting proudly, cute and expressive, full body.
qitt.texture: Warm orange tabby fur with darker stripes, white chest and paws, bright green eyes, pink nose.

thug.prompt: Rival-lane street thug of 1930s Damascus, stocky young man with stubble and a sneer, black tarboosh pushed back, olive-green striped qumbaz with the sleeves rolled, wide black sash, baggy dark trousers, leather slippers, holding a short wooden cudgel in his right hand, swaggering stance.
thug.texture: Olive and black stripes, black sash and tarboosh, dark wood cudgel, warm tan skin (not grey), arms straight out to the sides.

bandit.prompt: Orchard bandit of the 1930s Syrian countryside, broad bearded man with a grey-and-white checkered head cloth (keffiyeh) under a black cord, long dusty brown robe, crossed leather bandoliers over the chest, dark cloak, tall boots, holding a curved sword in his right hand, grim menacing face.
bandit.texture: Dusty brown robe, grey-white checkered head cloth, dark brown cloak, worn leather bandoliers, steel sword, tan weathered skin.

rider.prompt: Colonial-era mounted gendarmerie officer of the 1930s on foot, lean man with a thin handlebar moustache, dark blue kepi with a gold band, dark blue riding jacket with gold buttons and epaulettes, tan riding breeches, tall black riding boots with spurs, holding a sabre in his right hand and a riding crop tucked in his belt, arrogant upright pose.
rider.texture: Navy jacket with gold braid, tan breeches, black boots and spurs, steel sabre, light skin.

sapper.prompt: Military sapper of a 1930s colonial garrison, stocky man with a short beard, round steel helmet, dark grey work tunic with rolled sleeves, heavy canvas apron, leather gloves, a coil of fuse rope over the shoulder, holding a pickaxe in his right hand and a small powder keg under the left arm, dogged determined face.
sapper.texture: Dark grey tunic, steel helmet, tan canvas apron, brown rope, black-and-red powder keg, light skin.

sergeant.prompt: The Sergeant (shawish), a burly 1930s colonial gendarmerie sergeant, thick black moustache and a scar on the cheek, dark blue kepi with a red band, dark blue uniform with gold chevrons on the sleeves, brass buttons, wide belt with a holster, tall black boots, holding a heavy cavalry sabre in his right hand, barking furious face.
sergeant.texture: Navy uniform, gold chevrons and buttons, red kepi band, black boots, steel sabre, light skin.

colonel.prompt: The Commandant, the towering commander of a 1930s colonial garrison, tall man with a grey goatee and monocle, black kepi with heavy gold braid, long black greatcoat with gold epaulettes and a red sash across the chest, white gloves, polished black boots, holding an ornate officer's sabre in his right hand, cold imperious face.
colonel.texture: Black greatcoat, gold braid and epaulettes, crimson sash, white gloves, steel sabre with a gold hilt, pale skin.

prop_style: Stylized chunky cartoon game prop for a mobile tower-defense game set in a 1930s Damascus old-city lane, toy-like proportions, clean simple shapes, bold readable silhouette, hand-painted flat colors with soft shading, warm limestone and wood palette, single object centered, three-quarter view, no characters, no text, no background.

gate.prompt: The great double wooden gate of an old Damascus neighbourhood lane: tall stone arch of alternating black basalt and honey limestone stripes, two heavy wooden door leaves with rows of iron studs, a small wicket door cut into one leaf, a thick wooden bar across, an oil lantern hanging above.
gate.texture: Honey limestone and black basalt stripes, dark weathered wood, black iron studs, warm lantern glow.

barber_shop.prompt: Small 1930s Damascus barber and healer's shop front: stone doorway with wooden shutters, a wooden barber chair, a round wall mirror, a copper basin on a stand, a glass jar of remedies and a shelf of small bottles, a blank hand-painted wooden sign board.
barber_shop.texture: Limestone wall, dark wood shutters and chair, copper basin, green glass jars, cream sign board.

coffee_house.prompt: Corner of a 1930s Damascus coffee house: low wooden bench with a woven straw seat, a small round brass tray table with coffee cups, a tall glass narghile water pipe, a brass coffee pot on a small charcoal stove.
coffee_house.texture: Dark wood bench, golden straw, shiny brass, teal glass narghile, glowing charcoal.

bread_oven.prompt: Traditional domed bakery oven of a 1930s Damascus bakery: rounded stone and clay dome with an arched fire mouth glowing orange, a long wooden bread peel leaning against it, a stack of round flatbreads on a wooden board.
bread_oven.texture: Warm clay and soot-blackened stone, orange fire glow, golden bread, pale wood.

lantern_post.prompt: Wrought-iron street lantern from an old Damascus lane: hexagonal glass oil lantern with a pointed cap on a curved wall bracket, mounted on a short stone pillar, glowing warm light.
lantern_post.texture: Black wrought iron, warm amber glass glow, limestone pillar.

fountain.prompt: Small courtyard fountain of an old Damascus house: octagonal stone basin with black-and-white inlaid stone pattern, a central spout with water, potted jasmine at its rim.
fountain.texture: Limestone and basalt inlay, turquoise tiles inside the basin, clear water, green jasmine with white flowers.
